correctness.rationale: For connected undirected weighted L, the pair difference d^T(I+tL)^{-1}s is a rational function with poles at distinct negative inverse positive eigenvalues and numerator degree <=m-1<=n-2 after the mean mode cancels. Therefore every strict sign reversal requires a distinct positive numerator root, proving the upper bound. On P_n the n-1 distinct positive eigenvalues have nonzero first-edge eigenvector coordinate differences; partial fraction inversion realizes an arbitrary numerator with n-2 prescribed distinct positive roots via a real intrinsic s. A positive affine rescaling puts all s in (0,1) without changing roots. Global variance V(t)=sum a_k^2/(1+t lambda_k)^2 has strictly negative derivative for s nonconstant. An independent exact rational spectral/interpolation checker verified n3..6 and the exact n5 witness with roots 1,2,3. The proof is for equilibrium parameter variation, not temporal dynamics.

The mathematical contribution is the sharp pairwise order-crossing bound with full prescribed-node attainability on an unweighted path even while total variance decreases, not new diagonalization or monotonicity alone.
